summary: Static review of the v0.4 prototype rules: private user data is owner-scoped, joins require current capabilities, guest migration proves both identities, and room changes invalidate consensus. Syntax validation passed. No authorization or emulator tests were added or run in this implementation pass.

findings.issue: Venue and route facts are host submissions. Schema, membership, freshness and mutation permissions are checked, but the rules cannot authenticate a Transitous response or verify venue claims.
findings.recommendation: Keep provenance and host-review wording visible. A future independent verification service needs an authenticated backend and provider agreement.

findings.issue: Rules bound date length and format; calendar validity and past-date restrictions are enforced by the application.
findings.recommendation: Continue validating dates in the client. Do not treat a user-supplied date as a security authority.
